race.comment: CIGNETTI (10) resumes. He showed good ability in two runs last time in, third on debut at Pakenham before tackling the Listed Anzac Day Stakes and running a game fifth. Drawn wide but has plenty of early toe and Shinn on helps as well. The one to beat. OBSIDIAN STONE (11) is a gelding by Pierro on debut for the Greg Eurell yard who has jumped out well. He draws nicely and should go well. PASSIO (12) is a Too Darn Hot gelding on debut for the Price & Kent Jnr yard who is worth watching from a good draw off solid trial/jumpout form. ZOUDEADLY (6) is racing consistently and rates an each way chance.
